title: SLASH · The registration
venue: Box 4B · sixty pages · never lettered for print
logline: The photograph's back: a boat's registration number and a home port the framer has never heard of — GRAUSTARK, LA — in a hand that isn't the woman's. He measures the back as told and copies the number onto his cuff.

panels.composition: Top two-thirds: the photograph's back filling the panel — a boat's registration number and a home port, GRAUSTARK, LA, in a pen hand that isn't the woman's; the paper's grain; a thumbprint of ink at one corner.

image.prompt: black and white noir comic page, brush-pen over blue pencil, stark black spotting, the back of a photograph filling the frame with a boat registration number and a port name written in pen in an unfamiliar hand and an ink thumbprint at one corner, the paper's grain drawn
image.notes: The port: Graustark (Vol 8's river town) as an address on the back of a photo. The page draws it as pen strokes; only the port name is lettered.

panels.composition: Bottom third: the FRAMER's shirt cuff with the number copied onto it in ballpoint, the mat cutter's blade beside his wrist, the counter's edge.

image.prompt: black and white noir comic page, brush-pen over blue pencil, a man's shirt cuff on a counter with a number copied onto it in ballpoint strokes and a mat cutter's blade lying beside his wrist
image.notes: He measures the back as told. The number on the cuff is strokes, not digits.

art.line: brush-pen over rough blue pencil; rain in frantic vertical hatching; stark spotting; Arc 1's aesthetic pushed to noir
art.palette: black and white; one gray wash for the wet

notes: A port he's never heard of.
layout: two panels, top two-thirds and bottom third
